description: This file defines a report parser class for generating partner balance reports in Odoo (formerly OpenERP), including methods for date range calculations, data aggregation, and report setup.

classes.name: partner_balance
classes.description: A report parser class for generating partner balance reports, including methods for date handling, data aggregation, and formatting.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up context and local variables.

methods.name: date_range
methods.description: Generates a list of date strings between start and end dates.

methods.name: transform_period_into_date_array
methods.description: Converts selected periods into a date array.

methods.name: transform_date_into_date_array
methods.description: Converts specific start and end dates into a date array.

methods.name: transform_both_into_date_array
methods.description: Creates a date array based on periods and date range, adjusting start and end dates accordingly.

methods.name: transform_none_into_date_array
methods.description: Generates a date array covering the entire fiscal year or move line date range if no specific period or date is selected.

methods.name: comma_me
methods.description: Formats a number with thousand separators and two decimal places.

methods.name: set_context
methods.description: Sets the report context, including date ranges and account filters based on form input.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Fetches and processes partner move lines within the date range, returning aggregated data with subtotals.

methods.name: _add_subtotal
methods.description: Calculates and inserts subtotal lines for grouped account data.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit amount for the selected account IDs and date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit amount for the selected account IDs and date range.

methods.name: _sum_litige
methods.description: Calculates total blocked (litige) amount for the selected account IDs and date range.

methods.name: _solde_balance_debit
methods.description: Returns the net debit balance if debit exceeds credit.

methods.name: _solde_balance_credit
methods.description: Returns the net credit balance if credit exceeds debit.

methods.name: _get_company
methods.description: Retrieves the company name for the given form data.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the company's currency name for the given form data.
